Amazon Israel.description:
Our team is responsible for the AWS Neuron software stack, which powers Generative AI and other advanced ML workloads on AWS's custom-built ML accelerators — Inferentia and Trainium. These accelerators deliver best-in-class performance and cost-efficiency for ML inference and training in the cloud.
We're building a new core group of engineers in TLV (Tel Aviv) to drive innovation in ML systems performance and software. As a Machine Learning Performance Engineer, you'll help shape the direction of the team from the ground up and work on:

Optimizing system performance across the entire ML software stack
Analyzing high-performance ML workloads running on Annapurna hardware
Developing high-performance kernels for critical ML operations
Enhancing the Neuron SDK to improve developer experience and system capabilities
Collaborating across Compiler, Frameworks, and Hardware teams to maximize end-to-end performance

As part of the Performance Engineering Team, you'll contribute to projects involving instruction scheduling, memory management, parallelism, kernel optimization, and compiler enhancements to maximize end-to-end performance.

This is a unique opportunity to be at the intersection of ML and systems within AWS, helping to build the future of AI infrastructure — right here in Tel Aviv.


Key job responsibilities
Our engineers collaborate across diverse teams, projects, and environments to have a firsthand impact on our global customer base. You will:

Solve challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, at every layer of the stack.
Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security.
Research implementations that deliver the best possible experiences for customers.

A day in the life
As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects. You’ll also:

Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.
Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input.
Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

Considering the technical requirements of this role, and to ensure fair and equal candidate consideration, we are conducting full interview loops. If you meet the basic qualifications, and the team is interested in moving forward, we will be in touch to coordinate your interviews.

About the team
*Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

*Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Amazon Israel.title: Senior ML Performance Engineer, Annapurna Labs

Amazon Israel.description:
Be a part of operating the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure. Amazon Web Services is seeking bright, motivated, hardworking individuals to fill Datacenter Logistics Coordinator positions. The ideal candidate possesses a strong work ethic, attention to detail, the ability to meet deadlines, and a commitment to Operational Excellence.
The Logistics specialist reviews Datacenter inventory, in-bound shipments, and ongoing demand to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained in the all locations to support build and repair activities. Working with the Logistics Manager, they create plans to optimize the flow of parts through their lifecycle; tracking inventory location, movement, age, and turns. They work closely with Datacenter Operations Technicians and Datacenter Engineers to fulfill parts quickly and accurately. They work with Procurement and Hardware Engineering to purchase new parts and interface directly with vendors to process RMAs and receive replacements. They are responsible for accurate data entry and resolving questions from peer organizations.
The ideal Logistics specialist will dive deep into data to understand everything about the datacenter asset lifecycle. Working with software development teams, they will contribute to continuous process improvements to deliver on our goals of high availability and low cost. They maintain up-to-date metrics dashboards and will create reports for internal and external suppliers and management as required.
Responsibilities can include manual tasks, such as assembling, addressing, stamping and arranging for the shipment of merchandise and materials. They may also assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations. In handling incoming shipments, he or she may have to unpack boxes and verify contents. The Logistic specialist will be required to keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company.

The logistics specialist is also in responsible for reviewing tickets through remedy system and take necessary actions: order parts, picking, packing, stowing, and distributing materials. The expectation for this role is to follow established procedures, generate metrics for daily and weekly reviews, prepare standard operating procedures, risk assessments, method statements, and similar documents. Logistics specialists are expected to understand all aspects of production, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain very high quality, and be willing and able to work on powered equipment (i.e electrical pallet jack, lifter).



Key job responsibilities
Coordinate deliveries with carriers, receiving shipments, conducting receiving transactions, put-away parts on designated store locations, periodical cycle counts, removing parts out of the site (RMA, excess, forwarding to other sites), key focal point for all logistics operations for internal customers and external vendors, support other TLV sites upon the need.
Amazon Israel.title: Logistics Specialist, TLV Logistics

Amazon Israel.description:
Annapurna Labs develops innovative hardware solutions that powers the world's largest cloud infrastructure. We design custom silicon, including the Graviton processors and Nitro System components that underpin modern cloud computing. Our technologies are at the core of Amazon Web Services (AWS), powering their most critical services. We operate with the agility and ambition of a start-up, backed by the scale and impact of Amazon.

Our engineers tackle challenges across the full stack — we own every stage of silicon development, from architecture definition and design through verification, validation and system software.

You'll have the opportunity to work alongside amazingly talented engineers on technologies that serve millions of customers worldwide, in a dynamic, open, and fast-paced environment where your contributions directly shape the future of cloud computing.

We are looking for talented engineers to join our Virtual Platforms team. Virtual platforms play a crucial role in accelerating the development process by enabling early software development, system-level testing, and architectural exploration without the constraints of physical prototypes.

Key job responsibilities
As a Virtual Platform Engineer, you will:
• Create and maintain Virtual Platform environments for software development and system-level validation
• Optimize complex hardware-software interactions
• Drive collaboration across all development teams with a strong customer-obsessed approach
Amazon Israel.title: SW Engineer - Virtual Platforms

Amazon Israel.description:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Do you want to be part of the team helping start-ups become the unicorns of the future? Are you passionate about start-ups and how technology can help them accelerate their growth?
Do you have a business savvy and technical background to help establish AWS as a key technology platform provider and business partner to these companies?

If yes, come join the Enterprise Global team helping our most tech-savvy, ‘digitally native’ customers invent new services, engage new audiences and build their business.

As an Account Manager at Amazon Web Services you will have the exciting opportunity to help drive the growth and shape the future of an emerging technology for this segment of high potential set of digitally native customers. Your responsibilities will include focusing on scaling programs that drive adoption in named accounts, revenue, and market penetration across your assigned accounts.

The ideal candidate will possess sales experience in technology that enables them to drive an engagement at the CXO level as well as with software developers and IT architects. She/He/They will be a self-starter who will develop and execute against accounts coverage plans.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive revenue and market share in assigned digital native accounts.
• Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services.
• Maintain a robust opportunity pipeline.
• Work closely with HQ teams to meet customer needs and address escalations.
• Build and execute a strategic go to market plan for target markets in line with the AWS strategic direction.
• Work with partners to drive adoption of the AI/ ML solutions.
• Work with senior management team on market and sales strategy, AI/ML service roadmap, and initiatives to scale impact.

Amazon Israel.title: DNB Account Manager, Enterprise Global

Amazon Israel.description:
Are you a scientist interested in pushing the state of the art in Information Retrieval, Large Language Models and Recommendation Systems? Are you interested in innovating on behalf of millions of customers, helping them accomplish their every day goals? Do you wish you had access to large datasets and tremendous computational resources? Do you want to join a team of capable scientist and engineers, building the future of e-commerce? Answer yes to any of these questions, and you will be a great fit for our team at Amazon.

Our team is part of Amazon’s Personalization organization, a high-performing group that leverages Amazon’s expertise in machine learning, generative AI, large-scale data systems, and user experience design to deliver the best shopping experiences for our customers. Our team is building next-generation personalization systems powered by Large Language Models. We are tackling novel research challenges to help customers discover products they'll love - at Amazon scale and latency requirements. We are a team uniquely placed within Amazon, to have a direct window of opportunity to influence how customers will think about their shopping journey in the future.

As an Applied Science Manager, you will lead a team of scientists working at the frontier of LLM-based personalization. You will set the technical vision, drive the research agenda, and ensure your team delivers production-ready solutions. You will hire, mentor, and develop world-class scientists while fostering a culture of innovation and scientific rigor. You will partner closely with engineering and product teams to translate ambitious research into customer-facing impact, and represent your team's work to senior leadership.

Please visit https://www.amazon.science for more information.
Amazon Israel.title: Applied Science Manager, Personalization

Amazon Israel.description:
Annapurna Labs is a semiconductor company established by semiconductor industry veterans and is now part of Amazon Web Services. We develop leading edge products, manufactured with cutting edge technologies. We offer a dynamic, open, teamwork environment operating at a high pace. Join us and become part of an elite team working on new disruptive system architectures. We are growing and we're hiring people who are inspired by the opportunity to define and build the next generation semiconductor platform.

The Data Path HAL team is looking for an experienced Embedded Software Engineer, to join us in building the next generation of networking products. You’ll have the opportunity to work on the technologies that power the world’s largest cloud provider, in a dynamic, open, fast-paced environment.

In this role you will be leading tasks involving peers from multiple disciplines, while enjoying every step of the journey.
You will have the opportunity to work on the heart of the network engine, at the world’s largest cloud provider, in a dynamic, open, fast-paced environment.
For further information we invite you to watch the 2025 re:Invent keynote: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeUpUK0nhC0&t=4013s
Amazon Israel.title: Embedded Software Engineer - Nitro , Annapurna Labs

Amazon Israel.description:
We are seeking an Applied Scientist to help build Amazon’s next-generation customer memory and personalization systems.

Are you interested in building systems that move beyond reacting to customer behavior, to actually understanding and remembering it over time? Our team is building Amazon’s customer memory layer – a system that extracts, curates, and reasons over customer knowledge to power next-generation personalization. This includes transforming noisy, unstructured signals into durable, high-quality representations of customer preferences, intents, and life events, and using them in real time to improve customer experiences.

We are part of Amazon’s Personalization organization, a high-performing group that leverages large-scale machine learning, generative AI, and distributed systems to deliver highly relevant customer experiences.
We tackle challenging problems at the intersection of information extraction, knowledge representation, LLM reasoning, and recommendation systems. Our systems operate under real-world constraints of scale, latency, and quality, requiring careful tradeoffs between precision, recall, and responsiveness. This team plays a central role in defining how Amazon understands its customers, and how that understanding is applied across the shopping experience.

As an Applied Scientist, you will design and build ML and LLM-powered solutions for Amazon's customer memory and
personalization systems. You will work on how customer knowledge is extracted, validated, and applied in production
systems.

You will own the end-to-end delivery of ML solutions, from problem formulation and modeling to offline and online experimentation, and production deployment at scale. You will deliver high-quality, scalable systems that power customer-facing experiences.
You will drive work across areas such as fact extraction, memory quality and lifecycle, temporal reasoning, and grounded personalization, while navigating tradeoffs between quality, latency, and coverage.
You will collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to translate research into measurable customer impact.

Please visit https://www.amazon.science for more information.
Amazon Israel.title: Applied Scientist, Personalization, Personalization

Responsibilities
Own and define key product, business, and customer KPIs across the company
Analyze usage, funnels, monetization, and customer behavior to identify growth opportunities and friction points
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that give teams clear, reliable visibility into performance
Partner with Product and Business to evaluate new features, initiatives, and experiments, and measure their impact
Drive customer value by delivering external-facing data solutions, actionable insights, and industry benchmarks to empower data-informed decision-making.
Work closely with engineering and data stakeholders to improve data quality, structure, and accessibility
Help foster a data-driven culture by making insights understandable and actionable for non-technical stakeholders
Requirements
4+ years of experience as a Data Analyst / Business Analyst - Must
Strong hands-on experience with SQL - Must
Experience working with BI / visualization tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Metabase, or similar)
Proven track record of translating data into clear business insights and recommendations
Experience in gaming or B2C user-centric products -Must– strong focus on user behavior analysis, conversion funnels, and feature performance.
Strong analytical skills, including working with large datasets and complex models
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex findings for different audiences
Self-driven, curious, and comfortable working in a dynamic, high-growth startup
Experience with Python for data analysis (e.g. pandas, notebooks) and/or AI-based tools for analytics (e.g. AI copilots, LLM-powered analysis) - Advantage

Base44.description:
We're looking for a Creative Product Marketing Manager who lives inside the creative team. Someone who understands the product deeply, knows the audience and the competitive field, and turns all of it into stories worth telling. This role is built for someone who owns both the thinking and the doing. In your day to day you will:

  • Know the product inside out, including its strengths and weaknesses, how it stacks up against competitors, and where it is headed.

  • Stay in constant intelligence-gathering mode across every front we work on: product, competition, and user conversations. Know what people think of us, what they need, and where we fall short.

  • Deliver insights the team can act on, and spot product opportunities worth talking about.

  • Turn product capabilities into stories of value: know what to emphasize, how to frame it, and how to adapt it to different audiences and intents.

  • Own broad, ongoing responsibility areas end to end: gathering from multiple sources, filtering for quality, building AI tools and workflows to operate at scale, and carrying things through to production.

  • Take part in campaign and content creation across YouTube, web, and marketing channels: shaping concepts and seeing them through production with the team.

  • Create hands-on product storyboards within our design language, capture screen recordings, and drive video work alongside an editor and designer.
Base44.title: Creative Product Marketing Manager

Base44.description:
We are looking for an AI Content writer who is deeply passionate about content, messaging, and communication. In this role, you won't just write copy - you will be the master of our AI content engine. You will design the prompt systems, AI agent skills, and automated workflows that allow us to produce high-quality, on-brand content at scale. In your day to day you will:

  • Own the quality, tone, and clarity of  AI-generated content - ensuring automated communications, marketing collateral, and system copy sound natural and strictly on-brand.

  •  Design and refine prompts, custom AI tools, and agentic skills that automate routine

  • Work closely with PMMs to translate complex product strategies and messaging frameworks into scalable AI skills, ensuring complete product alignment without needing step-by-step guidance.

  • Feed AI systems with the right product context, audience profiles, and brand guidelines so every generated piece meets high editorial standards.

  • Constantly evaluate AI outputs, iterating on prompts and workflows to fix tone mismatches, fluff, or inaccuracies.
Base44.title: AI Content writer

Base44.description:
As Head of Security for Base44, you'll lead and implement security strategies, ensuring robust protection for our products, clients, and internal systems. With a dotted-line to the Wix CISO, you'll serve as Base44's primary security authority while ensuring full alignment with Wix's corporate security standards, policies, and enterprise-grade compliance requirements.

 

In your day-to-day, you will:  

 

  • Design, architect, and implement security features directly into our product codebase  
  • leading pre-sales security engagements meetings, executive security discussions, CISO-level reviews, and vendor security assessments while representing the company's security posture.  
  • Set standards and best practices across R&D and product teams as the sole internal authority for security  
  • Work closely with Wix CISO and the broader Wix Security departments to align Base44's security posture with corporate policies, compliance frameworks, and enterprise requirements
Base44.title: Head Of Security

Base44.description:
We're looking for an Senior AI Product Marketing Manager someone who lives and breathes AI and wants to channel that into marketing. Think of this as the growth hacker of 2026, you're AI-native first, marketer second. AI tools are your default way of working, You build with Claude Code or OpenClaw instead of spreadsheets and slide decks. If you've ever built an AI agent for fun, automated a workflow because you were bored, or shipped a side project using vibe coding - and you're excited about applying that energy to marketing - this role is for you.

In your day-to-day, you will:

  • Own marketing projects end-to-end - from strategy to execution - using AI as your primary working environment, not just an assistant
  • Create campaigns, landing pages, product content, and customer stories at a speed and volume that would be impossible without AI fluency
  • Build your own tools, automations, and AI workflows to solve marketing problems 
  • Run growth experiments across channels, rapidly testing messaging, creatives, and audiences to find what drives sign-ups and engagement
  • Lead product launches alongside Product and Growth teams - shaping positioning, messaging, and go-to-market plans
  • Stay on the bleeding edge of AI capabilities, constantly scouting new models and tools and figuring out how to apply them to marketing before anyone else does
Base44.title: Senior AI Product Marketing Manager

Base44.description:
At Base, we don’t do "traditional" support. We’ve built a strategic, business-focused Customer Experience organization that goes far beyond managing SLAs and resolution times. 

As our Head of Customer Experience, you will lead a unique, cross-functional global team of  L1/L2 Support, Team Leads, Business Analysts, and Content Writers.  This is an entrepreneurial, high-impact leadership role. You won’t just execute a roadmap given to you, you will define it.

If you are a leader who thrives under pressure, breathes data, understands B2C dynamics, and loves the challenge of driving operations  in a dynamic startup environment, this is the place for you.As our Head of Customer Experience you will:

  • ⁠Lead, mentor, and shape a global, cross-cultural team. You will be the driving force behind their growth, creating training materials,  establishing team rituals, and fostering a high-performance culture.

  • Constantly analyze key business metrics (workloads, backlog, staffing formulas) to ensure systemic stability, predict traffic spikes, and manage critical incidents flawlessly.

  • Actively scout, experiment with, and integrate cutting-edge AI tools into daily workflows to drive next-level automation and efficiency

  • Work seamlessly with cross functional teams to improve policies and process 

  • ⁠Build relationships across the company organically. Work independently and autonomously, driving impact without formal authority or constant supervision.
Base44.title: Head of Customer experience

Base44.description:
As a Demand Generation Manager, you'll drive multi-channel demand programs, manage ABM strategies, and optimize conversion funnels to generate pipeline contribution and revenue influence. You'll work closely with sales and other teams to create and execute targeted campaigns while analyzing performance to ensure continuous improvement. You'll also collaborate with the Base44 B2C user acquisition team and creative team to create holistic and converting content and campaigns.

In your day-to-day, you will: 

  • Own and execute multi-channel demand programs, running campaigns across paid, content syndication, and events targeting enterprise buyers 
  • Lead ABM strategy and execution, identifying and tiering target accounts, coordinating with Sales, and running account-specific plays across platforms like LinkedIn and others 
  • Manage the PLG-to-Enterprise conversion funnel, optimizing the path from self-serve sign-up to Sales-Qualified Accounts in collaboration with RevOps 
  • Drive pipeline reporting and campaign analytics by building dashboards to track key metrics and inform decisions 
  • Collaborate with Base44’s B2C user acquisition and creative teams to create holistic and converting content and campaigns 
  • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of demand generation strategies
Base44.title: Demand Generation Manager

Base44.description:
As a Motion Designer at Base44, you'll craft compelling visual narratives through motion, built on a strong foundation of design principles. You'll design for motion using composition, typography, and color, ensuring that movement naturally extends the brand’s visual identity and storytelling. In your day-to-day, you will:  

  • Develop styleframes and storyboards to establish the creative direction for projects  
  • Shape brand aesthetics through motion, ensuring consistency across digital platforms  
  • Collaborate with designers, animators, editors, and 3D artists to bring concepts to life  
  • Work closely with creatives and marketers to translate ideas into compelling motion visuals  
  • Think beyond animation- focus on storytelling, product experience, and visual impact  
  • Stay ahead of trends- explore new techniques in motion design, branding, and interactive visuals
Base44.title: Motion Designer

Base44.description:
We are seeking a highly accomplished AI Researcher to be part of the development of next-generation Foundation Models and Generative AI systems. In this role, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge academic research and production-grade AI infrastructure. You will build, design, and fine-tune large-scale architectures (including LLMs, Multimodal, and Tabular Foundation Models) while applying them to complex, real-world domains like agentic behavior, coding and decision making.

In your day-to-day, you will:

  • Conduct pioneering research in deep learning and generative AI, specializing in Foundation Models, NLP, alignment, and multimodal learning  
  • Deal with the impact of the models on production traffic, cost quality and latency
  • Train and scale state-of-the-art architectures using techniques like Post-Training SFT, Knowledge Distillation, LoRA, and sparse/hybrid model architectures  
  • Own the AI lifecycle—from algorithmic prototyping and synthetic data generation to deploying production-grade AI features in fast-paced or big-data environments
  • Drive research initiatives, author publications/patents, and collaborate with other research teams to integrate intelligent capabilities into core products
Base44.title: AI Researcher - Foundation Models & Generative AI

CHEQ.description:
as an integral part of the Data & AI Team, partnering directly with business stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities, translate business needs into technical solutions, and build AI products that automate internal processes and create immediate value.
The ideal candidate is a builder. You should be comfortable working with LLMs, AI agents, automation workflows, APIs, data pipelines, data warehouses, and internal company systems. You should also be comfortable taking ownership, asking sharp business questions, and moving ideas from concept to production.
Our Data Team has already built internal AI products at CHEQ. Now we are looking for someone who can help take us to the next level.
What We’re Looking For
The right person has built with AI in a real company environment and knows how to turn business needs into practical internal products. They should be comfortable working with stakeholders, understanding how teams operate, and identifying where AI can create meaningful value.
Because this role sits inside the Data & AI Team, they also need to be strong with data. That means working confidently with company data, data warehouses, pipelines, APIs, and the technical building blocks that make AI products reliable and useful.
This role is for someone hands-on, curious, and hungry to build. Someone who can combine AI, data, and business context to help CHEQ move faster, automate smarter, and turn ideas into measurable business wins.
What You’ll Do
Build end-to-end internal AI products, automations, agents, and workflows that solve real business problems across CHEQ.
Work directly with business stakeholders to understand pain points, define requirements, and turn ideas into scalable AI-driven solutions.
Design, prototype, test, deploy, and maintain production AI products using LLMs, AI agents, APIs, automation frameworks, and internal company data.
Work hands-on with data tools and infrastructure, including Snowflake, ETLs, data pipelines, APIs, AI tools, and internal servers.
Identify high-impact manual processes and turn them into automated AI-driven business wins.
Evaluate new AI tools, frameworks, and agentic workflows, and apply them where they can improve productivity, decision-making, or business operations.
Help shape internal AI development best practices around reliability, usability, security, documentation, maintainability, and production readiness.
Requirements
2–5 years of hands-on experience in AI Engineering, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Science, Analytics Engineering, or a similar technical role.
Proven experience building and deploying AI-powered products, workflows, agents, automations, or business solutions in a real company environment.
Strong hands-on experience with LLMs, AI agents, prompt engineering, RAG, workflow automation, APIs, or AI development frameworks.
Ability to code and build practical solutions using Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages.
Strong data experience, including ETLs, data pipelines, APIs, databases, data warehouses, and Snowflake.
Experience working in a SaaS or B2B technology company.
Strong business acumen, ownership, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently with stakeholders and drive projects from idea to production.
Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field - advantage
Advantages
Experience with agent frameworks, RAG systems, vector databases, orchestration tools, Snowflake, Airflow, Rivery, Gitlab, Claude, OpenAI, or similar tools.
Experience working in a cybersecurity or data company.

CloudHiro.description:
About the Role
We're looking for an exceptional analytical thinker to join CloudHiro and help organizations maximize the value of their cloud investments. This is an ideal opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who enjoys working with data, solving complex problems, and wants to build expertise in Cloud, FinOps, AI, and cloud optimization. You'll work with cloud usage data, identify optimization opportunities, support customers, and operate CloudHiro's optimization platform while learning from experienced professionals.
Responsibilities
• Analyze cloud infrastructure usage and cost data to identify optimization opportunities
• Monitor cloud environments and investigate anomalies
• Work with cloud optimization and FinOps platforms
• Support customers with insights and recommendations
• Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams
• Continuously learn cloud technologies, FinOps methodologies, and AI-driven optimization
Requirements
• Exceptional analytical skills and a strong problem-solving mindset
• Strong mathematical and logical thinking
• High attention to detail
• Curiosity and eagerness to learn new technologies
• Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets
• Excellent English communication skills
• Bachelor's degree in Economics, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - an advantage
• Basic SQL or scripting knowledge - an advantage
• Interest in cloud technologies, data analysis, or FinOps - an advantage
Apply for this position
CloudHiro.title: Junior Technical Operations Analyst

Cognyte.description:
Curious about what it’s like to work at Cognyte?

At Cognyte, you’ll collaborate with expert colleagues around the globe to solve problems most people will never even know exist!

You’ll be part of building unique solutions shaped by real investigative methodologies, enabling our customers to identify, investigate, visualize and prevent criminal, terror and security threats worldwide.

These solutions are used by law enforcement, national security, and national and military intelligence agencies in almost 100 countries to turn massive, diverse data into clear, actionable intelligence for a safer world.

Enjoy a hybrid schedule with office time at our R&D Hub in Bar Lev.

We are looking for a sharp, analytical, and detail-oriented Data Analyst with a strong finance background who enjoys investigating complex financial data problems, working with large transactional datasets, and digging deeper than the obvious answer.

As a Cognyter, you will:

  • Analyze complex financial data using SQL to uncover trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
  • Investigate data quality issues and perform root cause analysis on discrepancies and reconciliation breaks.
  • Build and validate matching, reconciliation, and data validation processes.
  • Develop and maintain BI dashboards and reports for business stakeholders.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and business teams to solve data-driven challenges and automate recurring analyses.
Cognyte.title: Data Analyst

Cognyte.description:
Today’s world is crime-riddled. Criminals are everywhere, invisible, virtual, and sophisticated. Traditional ways to prevent and investigate crime and terror are no longer enough…

Technology is changing incredibly fast. The criminals know it, and they are taking advantage. We know it too.

For nearly 30 years, the incredible minds at Cognyte around the world have worked closely together and put their expertise to work, to keep up with constantly evolving technological and criminal trends and help make the world a safer place with leading investigative analytics software solutions.

We are defined by our dedication to doing good and this translates to business success, meaningful work friendships, a can-do attitude, and deep curiosity.

We’re looking for a hands-on, highly technical and automation-driven Marketing Operations Manager who enjoys setting up workflows, connecting tools, and fixing day-to-day operational issues and making sure data, setups, and automations are accurate, consistent, and working as intended. 

This role is focused on execution - building and maintaining workflows, managing data, setting up campaigns, troubleshooting issues, and making sure our marketing operations run correctly day to day. 

As a Cognyter you will: 

  • Work hands-on in HubSpot every day, building and maintaining workflows, lists, forms, properties, reports, scoring models, and lifecycle automations. 
  • Set up and execute email campaigns and nurture flows, including segmentation, build, QA, testing, scheduling, and reporting. 
  • Maintain HubSpot data hygiene, including database cleanup, properties, naming conventions, user setup, and ongoing data checks. 
  • Manage lead uploads, segmentation, routing, lifecycle stages, and Marketing → SDR/Sales handoffs. 
  • Support the HubSpot–Salesforce integration and troubleshoot sync errors, workflow conflicts, data issues, and integration failures. 
  • Set up the operational side of webinars, including registration, integrations, tracking, lead processing, and follow-up. 
  • Build and maintain AI-driven and automated workflows for repetitive marketing and operational tasks. 
  • Regularly review existing workflows and automation to identify errors, outdated logic, or opportunities to simplify processes. 
  • Create and maintain documentation and best practices for workflows, processes, and system setup.

Cognyte.description:
Curious about what it’s like to work at Cognyte?

At Cognyte, you’ll collaborate with expert colleagues around the globe to solve problems most people will never even know exist!

You’ll be part of building unique solutions shaped by real investigative methodologies, enabling our customers to identify, investigate, visualize and prevent criminal, terror and security threats worldwide.

These solutions are used by law enforcement, national security, and national and military intelligence agencies in almost 100 countries to turn massive, diverse data into clear, actionable intelligence for a safer world.

The Purchasing Account Manager will be responsible for commercial ownership and performance of hardware suppliers and EMS (Electronics Manufacturing Services) subcontractors, supporting end‑to‑end manufacturing (PCBA, mechanics, cabling, system integration).

﻿As a Cognyter you will: 

  • Own the commercial relationship with EMS subcontractors and HW suppliers, including pricing, contracts, and ongoing governance
  • Lead EMS supplier strategy, selection, and commercial engagement across PCBA, system integration, and full build-to-print (BTP) scope
  • Drive cost optimization, pricing models, and total cost of ownership (TCO) across EMS and HW categories
  • Manage supplier performance (cost, quality, delivery), with focus on EMS operational KPIs and service levels
  • Support production ramp-up and resolve EMS-related supply, capacity, and execution issues
  • Lead escalations and mitigate risks (capacity constraints, BCP, compliance) within EMS ecosystem
  • Collaborate closely with R&D, Operations, QA, and Supply Chain on EMS manufacturing readiness and execution

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Support Specialist to help improve the effectiveness, consistency, and quality of our global support organization.

The role will focus on support process ownership, quality reviews, operational follow-up, and continuous improvement initiatives. Working closely with support managers and team leaders, this position will help ensure that support standards are consistently applied, improvement actions are executed, and customer-facing operations continue to evolve and improve.

As a Cognyter you will:

  • Lead complex pre-sales engagements from opportunity qualification through project award.
  • Design innovative solutions leveraging Cognyte's intelligence analytics, SIGINT, cyber, AI, telecommunications, big data, and cloud portfolio.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Lead cross-functional teams across Sales, Product Management, R&D, Project Management, and Finance.
  • Drive high-quality proposals, RFP/RFI responses, technical presentations, and business cases.
  • Present and influence decision-makers at both technical and executive levels.
  • Continuously expand your expertise and contribute knowledge back to the organization.

What Makes You Successful

You combine technical excellence, commercial thinking, and leadership capability

Technical Expertise

Experience in one or more of the following domains: SIGINT, telecommunications, cybersecurity, intelligence systems, RF technologies, big data, analytics, WEBINT, data fusion, AI/ML, cloud, or enterprise software platforms.

Business & Leadership Skills

  • Strong customer and commercial orientation.
  • Ability to architect innovative and commercially viable solutions.
  • Proven ability to lead without authority and drive cross-functional initiatives.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to solve complex problems

Communication Skills

  • Native-level English proficiency, written and verbal.
  • Exceptional writing, presentation, and storytelling capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with customers, internal stakeholders, executives, and senior management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in presales, solution architecture, consulting, system engineering, product management, or customer-facing technical leadership roles.
  • Experience leading complex RFI/RFP submissions.
  • Experience working with intelligence, defense, government, telecommunications, cybersecurity, or enterprise customers.
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Telecommunications, or related field.

In today’s fast-evolving, technology-driven world, organizations face increasingly sophisticated threats across cyber, financial crime, and national security domains. At Cognyte, we empower governments and enterprises with cutting-edge investigative analytics solutions that help make the world a safer place.

We are looking for a Sr. Director Sales Engineering to lead and scale our global presales activities, acting as a strategic partner to the Sales organization and a key driver of revenue growth. This is a high-impact leadership role for an experienced professional who combines deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, and exceptional stakeholder management skills.

As a Sr. Director Sales Engineering, you will build and lead a high-performing team, shape solution strategy, and play a critical role in winning complex deals by aligning customer needs with Cognyte’s innovative solutions.

As a Cognyter you will:

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing Sales Engineering/ Presales team, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous development.
  • Act as a strategic partner to the GM Sales, supporting go-to-market strategy and driving revenue growth across key markets.

  • Shape and standardize presales methodologies, tools, and best practices to improve efficiency, scalability, and win rates.
  • Provide market insights and competitive intelligence to influence product strategy and positioning.
  • Play a key role in strategic deals, supporting negotiations and ensuring technical and business alignment with customer requirements.

Freightos.description:
About the Role
Freightos is seeking an experienced finance leader to join our fast-paced team and help transform the global freight industry. As Director of Global Accounting & Reporting, you will lead our global accounting, external audit reporting, compliance, and finance operations. You will oversee the financial control environment across multiple international entities and serve as a key leader in ensuring the integrity of financial reporting and regulatory compliance for a Nasdaq-listed company.
This is a unique opportunity to play a critical leadership role in a growing global organization, ensuring financial excellence, regulatory compliance, and operational scalability.
Key Responsibilities
Lead all global accounting and tax activities across the company's international operations.
Provide overall ownership and oversight of the consolidated financial statements and external financial reporting requirements, ensuring timely and accurate delivery.
Manage relationships with external auditors and lead the annual global audit process.
Ensure compliance with IFRS, SEC/Nasdaq requirements, and local statutory regulations.
Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing monitoring of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance processes and internal control frameworks across the organization.
Oversee global tax compliance, tax planning, transfer pricing, and coordination with external advisors.
Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual period-end processes, ensuring timely and accurate reporting across all entities.
Support M&A activities, including financial due diligence, integration planning, and post-acquisition accounting.
Drive continuous improvement of finance processes, systems, integrations and internal controls to support the company's growth and scalability.
Partner closely with FP&A, Legal, Treasury, HR, and operational leaders on corporate initiatives and strategic projects.
Lead and develop a global finance organization across multiple international entities.
Manage and oversee the payroll process in several jurisdictions.
Requirements
CPA or equivalent accounting qualification.
At least 7 years of progressive experience in accounting, controllership, including experience in finance leadership roles.
Strong knowledge of multinational accounting, consolidations, external reporting, audit, and internal controls.
Experience working in a publicly traded company environment, preferably in a SEC-listed company.
Experience managing global accounting operations across multiple entities and jurisdictions.
Excellent communication, leadership, and project management skills.
Excellent English proficiency.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting M&A transactions, including due diligence and post-acquisition integration.
Experience leading SOX implementation or operating within a SOX-compliant environment.
Experience in multinational technology or transactional marketplace-type businesses.
﻿Why Freightos is the Perfect Port for Your Career!
We genuinely value work-life balance. We work hybrid, allowing you to enjoy quiet days at home, free from traffic, with in-office days, to meet your fabulous team face-to-face twice a week.
We believe that employees who get better make us all better. We strive for professional development and continuous learning. Alongside career support and guidance, you’ll receive an annual training budget for personal and professional development.
We don’t just offer jobs - we offer a stake in something bigger. As part of Freightos, you’ll be eligible to receive equity incentive grants that vest over time, aligning your success with the company’s long-term growth. The more we build together, the more you benefit.
A multicultural global team makes global freight easier. You’ll work with people from around the world, gain new perspectives, and experience diverse ways of thinking - fun and eye-opening!
Our office is based in Modiin, right across the train station. With great transport links, a beautiful view and a dynamic work environment, it’s the perfect place to collaborate and grow.
Location: Modiin, hybrid
Reports to: Senior Director, FP&A
Freightos is an equal opportunity employer, committed to treating all potential employees fairly and ensuring equal opportunities for everyone.

Gett.description:
As a Product Analyst, you will go beyond the numbers—defining, analyzing, and translating data into actionable insights about our business, users, and product features. You’ll also design and analyze both randomized and non-randomized experiments to optimize performance.
The ideal candidate is passionate about product analytics, user experience, and applied statistics, with a strong drive to make an impact by leveraging both quantitative and qualitative insights to inform business decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Perform deep-dive analysis, understand ML models and algorithms, and recommend how to improve them.
Conduct quantitative research to drive product recommendations, including cohort analysis, user personas, behavioral segmentation, forecasting, and impact analysis.
Design and analyse randomised and non-randomised experiments to optimise product performance and understand user behaviour.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to identify business needs and execute end-to-end analytical projects.
Deliver clear, effective presentations of insights to stakeholders at all levels, using visual representations of data.
Define key metrics, analyze usage patterns, and solve challenges that hinder progress toward objectives and key results (OKRs).
Lead independent research and develop new analytics methods during dedicated weekly project time.
Requirements
3+ years as a product analyst or business analyst - Must
BSc or MSc in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or Economics – Must
MSc with a specialization in Data Science – Advantage
Experience using AI tools (LLMs, GenAI assistants) to accelerate analysis and daily workflows – a strong advantage
Experience in evaluating ML Models - a strong advantage
Experience in SQL and Python– Must
Knowledge of statistics - Must
Experience and deep understanding of AB tests and the maths behind it - Must
Experience with Mixpanel or Amplitude - Nice to have
Experience working with BI-tools
Strong presentation and visualisation skills, ability to effectively communicate performance and business impact to the broader business
Ability to ask the right questions and use both quantitative and qualitative metrics to answer them
Experience in translating analysis results into product recommendations and business questions into an analysis framework
Experience with B2C mobile apps, Marketplaces, SaaS Platforms, and B2B products — advantage
English proficiency - Must

We believe that diversity drives innovation, and we’re proud to offer equal opportunities to all—regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic. If you need accommodations during the recruitment process, please contact us at recruitment.il@gett.com ,and we’ll do our best to support you. Click here to view our privacy policy.

Gett.description:
In this role, you will champion an AI-first approach, leveraging AI across every aspect of your work to optimize efficiency and drive innovation.
You will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, taking full ownership of complex systems and driving end-to-end processes. Your focus will be on supporting, enhancing, and automating our operations across various Gett business domains, including Sales, Service, and Marketing.
This hands-on role encompasses managing daily system maintenance, configuring systems, integrating AI-driven workflows , and overseeing projects from inception to completion.
Key Responsibilities:
End-to-End Project Management: Manage complex, cross-functional projects from initial ideation, through requirements gathering, to successful deployment and optimization.
Drive Innovation & Initiative: Act as a proactive change-agent. Identify business gaps, propose innovative solutions, and passionately push new initiatives forward to improve efficiency and performance.
System Ownership: Take full accountability and end-to-end ownership of the system’s health, functionality, and alignment with business goals.
Mentorship & Leadership: Guide, mentor, and upskill junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional excellence within the team.
Requirements
5+ years of experience as a Business Applications System Analyst or Project Manager, translating business requirements into technical design.
Advanced Salesforce expertise in configuration, administration, and enterprise automation (Flow Orchestration, complex Flows, and advanced business logic).
Experience implementing AI-driven tools and solutions to enhance business processes and system efficiency.
Technical proficiency in Salesforce APIs & integrations (REST, SOAP, event-driven) and hands-on experience with the Workato integration/iPaaS platform (mandatory) to orchestrate data flows and scale processes.
Familiarity with Salesforce development components (Apex triggers/classes, LWCs) to review and collaborate on technical solutions.
Solid understanding of Salesforce Governor Limits, asynchronous processing, data modeling, and designing scalable solutions for global, high-volume environments.
Ability to manage multiple end-to-end projects simultaneously , with a strong service-oriented approach for a diverse global customer base.
Fluent English and superb communication skills, with the ability to present complex solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
B.Sc. in Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent practical technical experience.

We believe that diversity drives innovation, and we’re proud to offer equal opportunities to all—regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic. If you need accommodations during the recruitment process, please contact us at recruitment.il@gett.com ,and we’ll do our best to support you. Click here to view our privacy policy.

Written by  Intuit Blog team .  Published Jan 9, 2025.  4 min read As we step into 2025, rapid advancements in AI—from agentic AI to enhanced security and code-free solutions—spark both excitement and skepticism. In this landscape, one thing is clear: the success of AI-powered experiences will ultimately be determined by end customers. They’ll be the final arbiters of what is useful, practical, and helpful, and what is merely hype. In this blog, we bring you perspectives from several Intuit tech leaders. They delve into the evolution of AI, highlighting how customer control, trust, and practicality will shape the future of technology. From agentic AI that balances autonomy with user authority to the convergence of payments, fintech, and AI, these insights offer a glimpse into the technologies that will define our digital world in 2025 and beyond. Agentic AI in 2025: striking a balance between autonomous efficiency and customer control In 2025, companies at the forefront of the agentic AI revolution will face a critical challenge: balancing the delivery of seamless, done-for-you experiences with the need to give customers ultimate authority and control over final decision-making, at their discretion.  To achieve this, innovation must focus on AI systems that seamlessly blend advanced autonomy with user-centric control, incorporating adaptive transparency, ethical safeguards, and context-aware learning to empower customer decision-making. These systems must foster trust through robust security and intuitive human-AI collaboration, ensuring efficiency while preserving user authority. Such agentic AI systems will not only be capable of autonomously planning, reasoning, and executing tasks to streamline processes and enhance efficiencies, but will instill customer trust and confidence. Written by  Intuit Blog team .  Published May 28, 2025.  3 min read Intuit’s Global Engineering Days (GED) is a weeklong code-a-thon that brings together Intuit technologists from all corners of the globe twice a year for a festival of innovation. Engineers, product managers, and designers form teams to work on projects of their choosing—a new idea for propelling business growth, addressing customer pain points, or streamlining work for each other. It’s a week to hit pause on the usual tasks and meetings, and instead focus only on innovation—working across team boundaries, creating rapid prototypes, and testing with customers. Participants are encouraged to be bold and think big. Hosted at 13 Intuit locations from San Diego to Toronto to Tel Aviv to Bangalore, the recent GED demonstrated impressive growth in employee engagement, with  nearly 8,500 participants , more than  2,800 projects , and over  900 teams  that showcased their work at closing day demofests, referred to as “gallery walks.”  Intuit’s steady investment and focus on AI and data over the past decade was apparent in the wide range of AI-related projects. Half of all project teams incorporated GenAI, and there was a significant focus on agentic AI—a rapidly evolving new technology. Project teams used AI agents to make our products faster and easier to use, from onboarding new QuickBooks Online customers, to automating routine administrative tasks for tax professionals, to navigating the complexities of credit card and auto insurance marketplaces. Some projects experimented with AI avatars, enabling users to give voice commands to an almost-human assistant. Some of the GED innovations were designed to directly benefit customers, while others were for internal use, helping Intuit employees be more productive and creative so they can deliver better customer solutions faster. Attend meetings throughout the day (support, 1:1s, arch meetings).   Meet with engineers 1:1 (hallway or scheduled) to check on them and find ways to improve/work on issues they are facing. Collaborating effectively: Large conference rooms and project rooms are designed for bigger group meetings, and provide optimized technology for hybrid and in-person collaboration. Focused productivity: Drop-in rooms and phone booths offer space for heads-down, distraction-free work or privacy for quick video calls. Networking & generating bold ideas: Team and huddle rooms are informal meeting spaces for casual team gatherings and offer a space to ideate or socialize between tasks or meetings. Intuit Israel.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Foundational Models and Agentic systems

Intuit Israel.description:
In this role you will define, design, and build groundbreaking AI solutions that understand, reason, and act across complex financial and business contexts.
You will collaborate closely with cross-functional experts across AI research, data science, engineering, and product to create intelligent agents that help SMBs automate financial tasks, make smarter decisions, and operate more efficiently. Your work will combine scientific rigor with visionary execution, balancing theoretical innovation with large-scale practical impact.
As a Staff Scientist you set technical direction beyond your own projects. You are a builder-scientist — a creative thinker who develops novel model architectures and training paradigms and also drives their implementation and validation in real-world applications — and you raise the scientific bar for the teams around you. You will help shape the AI foundation that powers transformative products serving millions of customers.
Responsibilities
Set technical direction. Define the technical strategy and roadmap for next-generation agentic and foundation-model systems, and drive innovation and scientific excellence across the organization.
Build foundational models and agents. Design and develop foundational language models and agentic architectures that power intelligent decision-making for small and medium businesses.
Advance the science. Explore novel approaches in large-scale pretraining, fine-tuning (SFT and RLFT/GRPO), retrieval-augmented generation, and reasoning to improve factuality, adaptability, and alignment.
Solve real financial work. Build intelligent agents that understand financial data, customer context, and business workflows — from bookkeeping and autonomous accounting to planning, communication, and insight generation.
Leverage Intuit’s data moat. Turn Intuit’s unique ecosystem signals — counterparty behavior, two-sided transaction visibility, and business twins — into defensible modeling advantages.
Ship end-to-end. Take work from experimentation to production, owning evaluation frameworks and metrics that prove real-world impact.
Elevate others. Mentor scientists and engineers, review technical designs, and grow the craft of the wider team — a core expectation at the Staff level.
Collaborate across functions. Partner with AI research, engineering, product, and design to translate breakthrough science into scalable products used by millions.
Share knowledge. Publish and present research findings, internal innovations, or contributions to open-source frameworks where appropriate.
Qualifications
Qualifications
Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Math, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field, with a track record of technical leadership on complex AI systems.
Proven experience with LLMs, multimodal, or foundation models — including pretraining, fine-tuning, and deployment.
Deep understanding of transformer architectures, reinforcement learning, reasoning models, and agentic systems.
Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML and agentic frameworks .
Demonstrated ability to build end-to-end AI pipelines, from experimentation to production at scale.
Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams and mentoring other scientists and engineers.
Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.
A passion for creating AI that augments human potential and simplifies complex business workflows.
Nice to have
Experience applying RL fine-tuning (GRPO, RLHF/RLFT) or model-based RL to language or decision-making systems.
Background in financial, accounting, or business-domain AI, or in probabilistic forecasting and world models is a major advantage.
Publications at top ML venues or meaningful open-source contributions.
Footer Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits ). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. Investing.description: Careers | Investing.com | Careers | Careers Who We Are Open Positions All Positions Head of Data Engineering Data Tel Aviv-Yafo Hybrid Full-time Investing.com, a leading global financial news and data platform, is looking for a Head of Data Engineering to join our Data team and play a key role in advancing our data platform and engineering capabilities. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad impact across the organization. You'll combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to establish best practices, introduce modern methodologies and technologies, and help shape the future of data engineering at Investing.com. Partnering with stakeholders across the organization, you'll build scalable data solutions, drive data quality and integrity, and identify opportunities to leverage AI to make our data platform smarter, more efficient, and more impactful. What you'll be doing: Drive Data Engineering Excellence Drive data governance, data quality, integrity, and engineering best practices. Introduce methodologies, tools, and standards that improve scalability, maintainability, and productivity. Improve data engineering processes, documentation, and workflows. Leverage AI & Innovation Identify opportunities where AI can improve data engineering workflows and operational efficiency. Explore, experiment with, and implement AI-powered solutions that address real engineering and business challenges. Collaborate & Deliver Partner with analysts, engineers, and stakeholders to deliver trusted, high-quality data solutions. Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. Build strong relationships with stakeholders by ensuring reliable and accessible data. Build Scalable Data Solutions Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end ETL pipelines, from business requirements through implementation. Develop scalable data models and optimize data warehouses for performance and reliability. Build and support complex data workflows using Python, BigQuery, Apache Airflow, and cloud technologies. Develop and maintain monitoring solutions to ensure the reliability and quality of data pipelines. What You'll Bring Technical Experience 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering. Strong experience with Python, SQL, BigQuery (or similar analytical databases), and Apache Airflow. Deep understanding of data modeling, ETL design, and cloud-based data platforms (GCP preferred). Experience designing complex business workflows and data processes. Experience with Tableau infrastructure. Familiarity with streaming data frameworks (Kafka, Pub/Sub). Data Engineering Leadership Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and engineering best practices. Experience introducing new technologies, methodologies, or standards. Ability to influence technical direction and improve how data engineering teams operate. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, align expectations, and drive collaboration across technical and business teams. Ability to translate complex technical topics into clear recommendations and drive initiatives forward. AI Mindset Experience using AI tools to improve engineering workflows and productivity. Curiosity and initiative to explore AI technologies and apply them to solve real engineering problems. Ability to identify opportunities where AI can create value and turn ideas into practical solutions. Who we are: Investing.com is a leading financial platform that helps retail investors and traders find opportunities others can't. 50 million investors rely on us every month, tracking 180,000 instruments across 250 exchanges, in 33 languages. More than 300,000 subscribe to our premium tools: AI-powered stock picks, Vision AI chart analysis, a personal AI research assistant, Fair Value assessments, and breaking news - getting institutional-level intelligence without the institutional-level fees. We're a global team of 250+ people who've been raising the bar on what's possibl

Investing.description: Careers | Investing.com | Careers | Careers Who We Are Open Positions All Positions Head of Analytics Data Tel Aviv-Yafo Hybrid Full-time At Investing.com, we're looking for a Head of Analytics to define and elevate how analytics is practiced across the organization. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad organizational influence. Beyond delivering insights, you'll define how success is measured, establish analytical standards and methodologies, and help teams across Product, Growth, Marketing, Sales Operations, and Content make better decisions with data. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, raise the analytical maturity of the organization, and help drive the next generation of AI-powered analytics. What You'll Do: Promote Data-Driven Decision Making Partner with Product, Growth, Marketing, Sales Operations, and Content teams to understand business challenges and enable better decision-making. Define KPI frameworks and measurement strategies that align with business goals. Translate complex business questions into clear analytical approaches and actionable recommendations. Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders, challenging assumptions and influencing decisions through data. Build Analytics Excellence Establish analytical methodologies, standards, and best practices across the organization. Lead the company's approach to experimentation, KPI definition, and performance measurement. Mentor analysts and help raise the overall analytical capabilities of the team. Promote a culture where data-driven decision-making becomes the default. Drive Product, Growth & Subscription Analytics Partner with teams across the customer lifecycle, from acquisition and activation through conversion, retention, and monetization. Analyze user behavior, subscription performance, pricing initiatives, and product changes to uncover growth opportunities. Connect analytical findings to clear business actions and measurable outcomes. Shape the Future of AI in Analytics Leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis, insight generation, and decision-making. Help design AI-powered analytical workflows and data analysis agents. Continuously identify opportunities to improve how analytics creates business value through AI. Improve Analytics Infrastructure Identify gaps in tracking, data quality, measurement, and reporting. Partner with data and engineering teams to improve data availability, reliability, and accessibility. Drive the development of dashboards, alerts, and scalable self-service analytics capabilities. Ensure business teams can confidently access and interpret the data they need. What You'll Bring Experience 8+ years of experience in analytics within a product-led SaaS or consumer-facing digital business. Proven experience partnering with multiple business functions, including Product, Growth, Marketing, and leadership. Demonstrated ability to lead complex analytical initiatives from definition through execution and business impact. Leadership & Communication Strong stakeholder management skills with experience influencing senior leaders without direct authority. Ability to establish methodologies, frameworks, and best practices that improve how organizations work with data. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex analytical concepts for different audiences. Analytical Expertise Deep understanding of KPI design, experimentation, customer lifecycle analytics, attribution, and performance measurement. Strong SQL skills; Python is an advantage. Experience with BI platforms, product analytics tools, and web/mobile analytics. Strong commercial and product mindset, with the ability to connect analysis to business outcomes. AI Mindset Hands-on experience using AI to improve analytical workflows. Curiosity and enthusiasm for applying AI to scale analytics and enable smarter decision-making. Investing.description: Careers | Investing.com | Careers | Careers Who We Are Open Positions All Positions Full-Stack Developer Technologies Tel Aviv-Yafo Hybrid Full-time Investing.com, a leading global financial news and data platform, is looking for a Full-Stack Developer to join our R&D team. As a Full-Stack Developer, you will design and build high-scale web applications used by millions of users worldwide. You will take ownership of complex features end-to-end, contribute to system design decisions, and play a key role in driving AI innovation across engineering. We are looking for someone who not only builds great software but also proactively identifies opportunities where AI can solve real business and engineering challenges, defines the right approach, and delivers practical solutions that create impact. What You'll Do Build Scalable Products Design and develop scalable, high-performance web applications across the stack. Own features from technical design through implementation, testing, and production deployment. Improve system architecture, performance, and reliability in a high-traffic environment. Work with large-scale databases and caching solutions. Conduct code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices. Drive AI Innovation Identify opportunities where AI can improve products, engineering workflows, and development efficiency. Explore, experiment with, and implement AI-powered solutions that address real business and technical challenges. Collaborate & Deliver Work closely and collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical solutions. Contribute to technical discussions and continuously improve engineering practices. What You'll Bring Technical Experience 5+ years of hands-on experience in software development. Proven experience building and maintaining production systems at scale. Strong full-stack development experience with technologies such as Node.js, React, and Go. Strong experience working with SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL), caching solutions (e.g., Redis, Memcached), and cloud environments (preferably GCP). Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines. Solid understanding of system design, scalability, and performance optimization. AI Mindset Experience using AI tools to improve development workflows and productivity. Ability and willingness to explore AI technologies and apply them to solve real problems. Proactive mindset with curiosity to experiment, learn, and turn ideas into practical solutions. Ways of Working Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to understand the business need behind technical challenges. Ability to work independently, take ownership, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Who we are Investing.com was founded in 2007 and now has over 250 employees worldwide. With 60 million monthly unique visitors, 4 billion page views, over 500 million sessions, and over 300,000 financial instruments covered, Investing.com is one of the top two global financial websites. Investing.com offers unlimited access to cutting-edge financial market tools, including real-time quotes and charts, customized portfolios, personal live alerts, calendars, calculators, and financial insights, all completely free of charge. In addition to global stock markets, Investing.com also covers world indices, ETFs, commodities, bonds & interest rates, cryptocurrencies, futures, and options. Investing.com strives to be a one-stop shop for traders and investors with apps available. What we offer A chance to join one of the leading financial market platforms worldwide Challenging assignments in a local and international environment Enjoy excellent benefits and a high-energy working environment As with all Investing.com positions, we're looking for someone self-motivated and meticulous, with a creative and resourceful mind, who is bright, proactive, and works well independently and as part of a team. NetApp's AI Transparency Statement  At NetApp, we are committed to transparency, responsible innovation, and delivering a hiring experience that is efficient, equitable, and distinctly human. As part of this commitment, we use AI-enabled tools in select parts of our recruitment process to support consistency, efficiency, and fairness – while keeping people at the center of every decision.  This statement explains what AI tools we use, how they work, what safeguards are in place, and what choices you have. We also have an  FAQ  document where you can learn more information.  The tools we use  Depending on the role and location, some parts of our recruitment process may be supported by AI-enabled tools provided by third-party platforms, including Findem (findem.ai) and Eightfold (eightfold.ai). These tools assist our recruiters. They do not replace human decision-making. All decisions about whether to progress or reject a candidate are made by people.  How we use AI in recruitment  We use these tools in the following ways:  Candidate sourcing and matching:  we use AI-powered platforms to help identify candidates whose skills and experience may be relevant to open roles at NetApp. These platforms review publicly available professional information and provide our recruiters with a relevance score that reflects how closely a candidate’s background aligns with the requirements of the role. The score helps our recruiters prioritise which candidates to review – it does not automatically reject or exclude any candidate.  Applicant matching:  for certain roles, AI may be used to evaluate candidates’ skills and experience based on information provided in their application, compared against the requirements of the role.  AI-assisted conversation:  for certain roles and in certain countries, an AI-assisted conversation may be used to conduct an initial informational intake with candidates. If you are invited to participate, you will be clearly informed in advance. The AI evaluates your responses against role-specific criteria defined by our hiring team.
